newsitem.title: ISRAEL: SOCCER-ISRAEL MISS LEADING PLAYERS AGAINST GERMANY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ISRAEL MISS LEADING PLAYERS AGAINST GERMANY.

text.p: Israel coach Shlomo Scharf will be without three key players for a friendly against Germany in Tel Aviv on Wednesday.
Midfielders Eyal Berkowitz of English premier league Southampton and Haim Revivo of Spanish first division Celta Vigo have failed to secure releases from their clubs.
The third major absentee is injured Tal Banin of Hapoel Haifa, an inspiration in the past through his committed style of play.
The only unenforced change sees Hapoel Haifa goalkeeper Rafi Cohen recalled at the expense of Itzik Kornfein of league leaders Betar Jerusalem.
Veteran striker Ronnie Rosenthal of England's Tottenham Hotspur is the only foreign-based player in the squad.
Injury may prevent long-serving captain Nir Klinger from making his 81st international appearance.
The German squad were arriving in Israel on Monday. They were due to visit Yad Vashem Holocaust memorial centre and the Knesset on Tuesday.

This is the first match between the two countries since German unification. West Germany played in Tel Aviv in 1987 winning 2-0 through goals by Lothar Matthaeus and Olaf Thon. They have yet to meet on German soil.

Israel squad: Goalkeepers: Rafi Cohen (Hapoel Haifa), Golan Malul (Maccabi Petah Tikva). Defenders: Assi Domb (Betar Jerusalem), Arik Bennado (Maccabi Haifa), David Amsalem (Betar Jerusalem), Amir Shelah (Maccabi Tel Aviv), Gadi Brumer (Maccabi Tel Aviv), Felix Halfon (Hapoel Tel Aviv). Midfielders: Ran Ben-Shimon (Haopoel Haifa), Alon Harazi (Maccabi Haifa), Yossi Abuksis (Betar Jerusalem), Shmuel Levy (Betar Jerusalem), Avi Nimni (Maccabi Tel Aviv), Itzik Zohar (Betar Jerusalem), Alon Hazan (Maccabi Haifa), Nir Klinger (Maccabi Tel Aviv, captain). Forwards: Eli Ohana (Betar Jerusalem), Ronnie Rosenthal (Tottenham Hotspur, England), Alon Mizrahi (Bnei Yehuda).
